mentions.name: Non-public feed aggregation project
mentions.description: A non-public project similar to GreatReads that remixes existing feeds and creates new feeds from syndicated blog content, dealing with a mix of formats such as RSS and Atom through normalizing and sanitizing of content.
mentions.source_excerpt: Doing something similar for a non-public project. How do you deal with remixing feeds, and the potential mix of formats (rss, atom, etc)? I need to create new feeds as well, and if its done by normalizing, sanitizing content, etc.
